productionContract.contract: sessionWorkDir=/home/dev/work, sessionWorktreeAdminDir=/home/dev/work/.git/worktrees. Main worktree bind writable by default; nonempty worktreeAdmin adds one ReadOnly mount at exact nested destination.

For primary ordinary .git directory, ensure ordinary .git/worktrees exists, reject symlink or irregular/reparse .git and worktrees entries, then Confine admin into worktree. Linked .git regular file returns no admin mount.
Create and Restart both call sessionWorktreeAdmin and sessionMounts; primary admin mount is expected on both allocations.
Backend directly renders HostPath:ContainerPath and appends :ro for ReadOnly, then passes binds to Docker HostConfig. It does not independently make arbitrary source-path validation promises.
Confine resolves symlinks/canonical paths then tests containment. Caller Lstat is load-bearing for reparse-point refusal, including in-worktree links.
Shell private home is a distinct state-backed mount; its presence does not justify arbitrary project-descendant binds.
